purpose: Product demonstration of requirement-sensitive geographic and temporal screening.
replacement_target: DSO/TSO asset ratings, planning model, operational loading, security criteria and connection queue

calculation.firm_envelope: minimum of synthetic transformer, upstream branch, voltage-security and contingency limits
calculation.flexible_envelope: hourly conditional operating limit; customer flexibility and BESS are simulated separately and do not create network capacity
calculation.uncertainty: P10/P50/P90 band across deterministic scenario hours; not a statistical confidence interval

limitations: No operator asset ratings, SCADA loading, protection settings, fault levels or connection queue are used.
The hourly profile is not trained on node-level German operational data.
Outputs are neither free, available, connectable, reserved nor operator-confirmed capacity.
